messages.body_plain:
A checksum is computed locally for each file uploaded, and then when the uploaded bundle is extracted those checksums are checked.
The more files in the bundle, the longer that takes.
Since this is more a function of the number of files, than of size, you can work around this by putting files into a .zip or .tar file and having your application expand it when it starts. Obviously this advice applies only to data files and not to the application source itself.
HTH.

library(shiny)

options(rgl.useNULL=TRUE)
open3d(useNULL = TRUE)

  rglwidgetOutput("wdg")
))
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  options(rgl.useNULL = TRUE)
  save <- options(rgl.inShiny = TRUE)
  on.exit(options(save))
  output$wdg <- renderRglwidget({
    rglwidget(scene)
  })

if (interactive())

messages.subject: Rstudio incorrectly checks xpath and returns an error when publishing.
messages.subject_clean: Rstudio incorrectly checks xpath and returns an error when publishing.
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

Rstudio sensibly tries to flag apps that won't work once published based on the location of local data. However, the checker is a bit overzealous and mistakes parsing of xml as the user trying to read in data. For example

I am interacting with a web API. I then need to do some parsing of the xml.

 r<-wcPOST()
  start_epoch <- as.numeric(now() - lubridate::days(days_lag))

  #Get program number
  xpath <- paste("//data/deployment/argos/last_uplink_date",
                 "[number() > number(", start_epoch, ")]/../program_number", sep = "")
  program_number <- XML::xpathSApply(XML::xmlParse(content(r,"text")), xpath, XML::xmlValue)

This all works great locally. Note there is no interaction with the local file system. But when I go to publish I get. "Paths should be to files within the project directory".

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-U4o9N0NnmHA/WoHdhIjgK5I/AAAAAAAAMXI/Wi4sXFbvAqAkPWV_HlrctCj_FgmR0MZEACLcBGAs/s1600/Screen%2BShot%2B2018-02-12%2Bat%2B10.25.23%2BAM.png>

Is this the correct place to report this error? It is currently limiting me from publishing.

Thank you.

messages.body_plain:
Hi all,
I try to deploy an apps and it shows error as below:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 290511...Error:
* Application depends on package "reshape2" but it is not installed.
   Please resolve before continuing.
Execution halted

Then I tried default simple apps and added library(reshape2), got the same error message.

Thank you!

# This is a Shiny web application. You can run the application by clicking
# the 'Run App' button above.
#
# Find out more about building applications with Shiny here:
#
#    http://shiny.rstudio.com/
#

library(shiny)
library(reshape2)

# Define UI for application that draws a histogram
ui <- fluidPage(

   # Application title
   titlePanel("Old Faithful Geyser Data"),

   # Sidebar with a slider input for number of bins
   sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
         sliderInput("bins",
                     "Number of bins:",
                     min = 1,
                     max = 50,
                     value = 30)
      ),

      # Show a plot of the generated distribution
      mainPanel(
         plotOutput("distPlot")
      )
   )
)

# Define server logic required to draw a histogram
server <- function(input, output) {

   output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
      # generate bins based on input$bins from ui.R
      x    <- faithful[, 2]
      bins <- seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = input$bins + 1)

      # draw the histogram with the specified number of bins
      hist(x, breaks = bins, col = 'darkgray', border = 'white')
   })
}

# Run the application
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
